params.name: return_ip_location
params.description: IP responses will not include location data for the IP by default.  Setting to `true` will return IP specific location info.

params.name: return_ip_metadata
params.description: IP responses will not include metadata for the IP by default.  Setting to `true` will return IP specific metadata.

params.name: return_person
params.description: Setting to `true` will return person fields associated with the IP.

params.name: return_if_unmatched
params.description: Setting to `true` will return IP specific metadata or location data regardless of a company match.

params.name: titlecase
params.description: Setting to `true` will titlecase any records returned.

params.name: pretty
params.description: Whether the output should have human-readable indentation.
